entries.subject: eso-wfi shipped image lens
entries.finding: Default B/V/R photograph, 7059 by 6535 pixels over 28.02 by 25.94 arcmin; source-relative astrometric anchor. Its finite footprint misses some bright outer halos and cannot alone provide all compact image anchors.

entries.subject: eso-vista shipped image lens
entries.finding: Y/J/K photograph, 6592² pixels over 37.51 arcmin square; 794 held-out stars give 0.34 arcsec RMS relative to WFI. Outer color and five retained compact cores extend beyond WFI; overlap astrometry is not absolute calibration or membership.

entries.subject: eso-wide shipped image lens
entries.finding: Wider ESO 3.6 m photograph, 6850 by 4759 pixels over 48.82 by 33.92 arcmin; filters unspecified. The 229 held-out stars give 1.10 arcsec RMS relative to WFI. Softer structure/artifacts remain; one retained compact core comes from this source.

entries.subject: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry and Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric distances
entries.finding: 6627 Gaia candidates in an authored 50 pc sphere, G < 16; 1466 Gaia points share a total 1500-point budget with 34 conditional image anchors. Actual catalogue source IDs, median distances and uncertainty intervals are retained. Sphere, quality cuts, budget, brightness response and fade are display selections, not a membership survey; Cardiel BP-RP display color uses a neutral fallback outside its valid range.

entries.subject: Benedict central-star parallax scale
entries.finding: The adopted 216 -12/+14 pc scale follows the published central-star result, with an explicitly chosen ICRS centre. It is not the distance of every surrounding star or emitting knot.

entries.subject: Zeigler HCO+ component catalogue and joint fit
entries.finding: The retained 279 measured components constrain a coarse molecular scaffold where supported. Source-count discrepancy, finite beams, equal front/back allocation and unsupported diffuse depth remain explicit; not every optical knot has velocity coverage.

entries.subject: 34 source-proven compact image anchors
entries.finding: 28 WFI, five VISTA and one wider-ESO core restore visual anchors, including the central star. Canonical source photometry remains visible outside an individual lens footprint. Angular Gaia matches and component offsets are separately recorded; depths stay conditional, and one VISTA edge core has no Gaia match.

entries.subject: First 28-core WFI-only retention
entries.finding: The initial correction placed selected cores accurately but missed upper bright halos outside the WFI star footprint. Increasing random top-N points could not repair that source-coverage failure; the three-image union supersedes it.
entries.revisitWhen: Reopen only if the wider-source compact detections are disproved by source evidence; do not replace them with unrelated offset points.

entries.subject: Historical Hubble/CTIO photograph
entries.finding: The 4731 by 3129, 20.96 by 13.86 arcmin composite clips outer emission. It remains the source for historical central-detail trials, not the current three-lens compiler.
entries.revisitWhen: Use as a local-detail contribution only after qualified registration and an explicitly bounded footprint; it cannot replace missing outer observations.

entries.subject: One-axis and O’Dell disk/ring baselines
entries.finding: Both initial models failed visual inspection: the one-axis image fit becomes a box, while the published-geometry disk/ring allocation is smooth, drops outer signal and changes brightness under rotation. Widths and weights were authored, and front agreement was imposed by allocation.
entries.revisitWhen: A replacement must represent independent wider structure and improve the same side/oblique failures, not rescue them with exposure or resolution.

entries.subject: Historical detector and tuned ring-sector fits
entries.finding: The saved annulus/rim/arc hypotheses preserve explicit widths and depths but remain too smooth, lose fine filaments and show side slab structure. Their residuals include stars/background and do not establish accuracy.
entries.revisitWhen: Revisit only with qualified independent geometry or structure evidence and the same fixed-camera morphology gate.

entries.subject: Separate ionized-core slit digitization
entries.finding: The figure-9 O III digitization remains a separate velocity view; it is not the molecular component catalogue or a whole-nebula reconstruction.
entries.revisitWhen: Qualify tracer-specific spatial/velocity uncertainty and a joint forward comparison before using it to constrain the current volume.

entries.subject: CFHT/Coelum optical comparison
entries.finding: The inspected public composite still clips upper extended structures; its high-resolution version requires a request. It is not a compiler input.
entries.revisitWhen: Obtain a usable native image with terms and WCS, then verify broader useful coverage and independent stellar registration.

entries.subject: Chatzifrantzis 2025 APOD image
entries.finding: The photograph shows strong outer structure but is watermarked and lacks supplied astrometric registration. APOD hosting does not make it a NASA observation or confer derivative rights.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire permission and a suitable native unwatermarked source, then qualify astrometry and full footprint.

entries.subject: Bipolar, barrel and infrared-halo interpretations
entries.finding: O’Dell 2005, Meaburn 2005, Herschel 2015 and Zhang 2012 identify nonunique outer geometry and roughly 40-arcmin infrared halo extent. These alternatives are not implemented; summaries alone do not qualify a depth map or prove the selected images cover all emission.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire and inspect the original tracer data/model parameters with uncertainties and compare alternatives on their valid footprints.

entries.subject: Contaminated halos, VISTA streaks and unsupported depth
entries.finding: Bright stellar halos survive NOX and some nebular knots enter the residual. Compact anchors improve the visible cores but leave that cloud contamination and the uncertain outer depth intact; registration and exact source accounting are not star-removal or material acceptance.
entries.revisitWhen: Audit source separation and finite emission with positive source evidence, retaining real knots and verified compact anchors, then inspect the same spectral front/side views.
